definition: The logical and stylistic consistency of a generated text, measuring whether ideas flow sensibly and the output reads as a unified whole.
details: Coherence is one of several qualitative dimensions (alongside fluency, relevance, and faithfulness) commonly assessed in both human and automated evaluation of generated text.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Coherence.
